The geometry leads to the equation  

\[
\frac{2}{5}s = 2\sqrt{R^{2}-\left(\frac{9r}{10}\right)^{2}},\qquad 
R^{2}= \frac{s^{2}+r^{2}}{4},
\]

which simplifies to  

\[
21s^{2}=56r^{2}\;\Longrightarrow\;\frac{s^{2}}{r^{2}}=\frac{8}{3}.
\]

Hence  

\[
\frac{s}{r}= \sqrt{\frac{8}{3}}=\frac{2\sqrt6}{3}.
\]

**ANSWER: \(\displaystyle \frac{2\sqrt6}{3}\)**
